actions.value:
import qp1ng

mode = qp1ng.get_var('MODE', 'NORMAL')
tor = qp1ng.get_var('TOR_STATUS', 'UNKNOWN')
result = f'SDK OK | mode={mode} tor={tor}'

qp1ng.set_var('PYTHON_SDK_LAST_RESULT', result)
qp1ng.notify('Q-P1NG Python SDK', result)
qp1ng.output(result)
